title: W006 Excel MSForms OLE drag/drop DataObject oracle fixture

cleanRoom.source: Repo-owned manifest and VBA source consumed through public Excel/VBIDE automation, public MSForms event handlers, public MSForms.DataObject methods, and public Windows SendInput mouse input.
cleanRoom.prohibited: No Office internals, decompilation, disassembly, private implementation details, or binary inspection.

prerequisites: Windows desktop session with Microsoft Excel installed.
Excel macro execution allowed for the generated workbook when opening the fixture.
Trust access to the VBA project object model enabled when generating through automation.
The Microsoft Forms 2.0 UserForm designer available through Excel/VBA.
A desktop session where public user32 SendInput mouse down/move/up can be delivered to the UserForm.

form.name: OxFormsW006OleDragDropForm
form.caption: OxForms W006 OLE Drag Drop Oracle

dragSeed.provenance: Literal repo-owned value set by fixture VBA into a public MSForms.DataObject before DataObject.StartDrag.

manualInteractionScript: Press on SourceDragLabel, move to TargetDropTextBox, and release.
Export W006OleDragDropEventLog as CSV and JSON.
Classify true OLE drag/drop as captured only if live BeforeDragOver and BeforeDropOrPaste rows are present.

notes.scope: This fixture builds repo-owned Excel/MSForms oracle inputs only. It does not implement OxForms behavior.
notes.events: Event handler names and argument names follow docs/specs/FM20_EVENT_FACTS.md.
notes.dataObjectPolicy: DataObject logging uses public MSForms.DataObject methods only. The known repo-owned drag seed text may be identified by seed id; unexpected payload text is not recorded.
notes.generatedArtifacts: Generated .xlsm files, screenshots, logs, exported worksheets, and hashes belong under docs/evidence/W006_control_implementation_rollout/captures/ when captured.
